sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - This key does not open any lock. It's a quest item only.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text: - Used in the quest Key to the City from Ragman

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The engraving "05.08 2016" on the handle refers to the start of the Closed Alpha of the game, even though it was actually August 4, 2016.
